column3: With respect to the Hamilton Place Mortgage Loan (4.6%), the related borrower sponsor, along with other borrower sponsor affiliates, filed a voluntary Chapter 11 bankruptcy on November 1, 2020. On November 1, 2021 the borrower sponsor emerged from bankruptcy with all matters in the bankruptcy having been resolved, except for the resolution of some disputed claims, which claims have been separately reserved for with an independent third party. As a result of the bankruptcy, outstanding loans guaranteed by the borrower sponsor were deemed to be in default; however, the borrower sponsor worked with servicers to obtain waiver agreements with regard to all loans deemed to have been in default due to the bankruptcy filing.
